data.name: Flagbearer
data.description: When brandishing a flag adorned with the standard of an organization you owe allegiance to, you inspire nearby members of the same allegiance. Grant bonuses to allies who see your flag. When brandishing a flag adorned with the standard of an organization you owe allegiance to, you inspire nearby members of the same allegiance. As long as you hold your clan, house, or party's flag, members of that allegiance within 30 ft. who can see the flag (including yourself) gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and saving throws against fear and charm effects. You must hold the flag in one hand in order to grant this bonus. If the standard is taken by the enemy or destroyed, this bonus becomes a penalty, affecting all creatures that the bonus previously affected for 1 hour (or until you reclaim the lost flag).
